blocks.text: Audit logs track user-initiated actions within the Agentic Security Operations Platform (Agentic SecOps Platform). This enables you to monitor configuration changes, such as updates to reports, data source instances, and outegrations. You can download specific audit logs for immediate review, and schedule automated exports to an external destination such as an Amazon S3 bucket.
Audit logs track key events including:

blocks.item: Configuration of grouping rules and rule sets.
Configuration of severity, score, and SLA settings.
Creating, managing, and assigning roles and content permissions.
Configuring field unification rule set.
Configuring UI configurations.
Updates to account settings and user settings.
Management of data source mapping, data source instances, and data source scheduling.
Configuration and mapping of outegrations.
Changes to dashboards and reports.

blocks.text: To view the Audit Logs page:

blocks.item: In the Agentic SecOps Platform Admin Portal, go to a configuration page:
For a user: Click the Profile menu in the top navigation bar, then click Profile Settings.
For an account: Click the Profile menu in the top navigation bar, then click Account Settings.
For a source: Go to Configure > Sources, then click a source.
For an outegration: Go to Configure > Outegrations, then click an outegration.
For a report: Go to an application in the top navigation bar (Vulnerabilities, Assets, etc.), click My Reports, and click a report.
For SOC Workbench only: Go to Settings > Scoring, Settings > Severity, or Settings > UI Config.
The configuration page for a user is provided here as an example.

Click the More menu, and click Audit Logs.
The Audit Logs page appears.
On the Audit Logs page for a user, you can do the following:
Filter and sort the logs by operation, type, and user name.
Download the logs as a CSV file.
View additional information by clicking the arrow icon.

blocks.text: Audit logs are retained for 90 days. To extend the retention period and to maintain a long-term history, you can export the logs to an Amazon S3 bucket or any other configured log destination.
You can schedule audit logs to be sent on a daily or hourly basis via an outegration. To learn more, see Creating Outegrations.
To configure automated audit log export for a user:

blocks.item: Click the Profile menu in the top navigation bar, then click Account Settings.
The Settings page appears.
In the Audit Logs Export section:
Select Enable Scheduling.
Included Entities: Select the entity types to be included in the audit log (e.g., Severity Score Settings, UI Configuration).
Frequency: Define the time interval for the audit log export (e.g., Daily or Hourly).
Select Storage Outegration: Choose a destination for the audit log export.
See image.
Click Save.
Audit logs are automatically exported to the selected storage outegration based on the scheduling frequency.
